# Integer bit operations. band/bor/bxor are commutative; the shifts
# bsl/bsr/busr are non-commutative (handler computes `args[1] OP args[0]`),
# so the SWAP form `value bsl count` reads naturally (`1 bsl 4 = 16`).
# §3  shifts — non-commutative; swap form reads `value shift count`
